costNote: Scene cost is measured from mounted geometry, not an isolated-asset GPU benchmark. Network figures include the complete navigation system. Environment draws are additional.

assets.name: StarrSeed
assets.concept: A sixfold living capsule holding a luminous core, a Fresnel shell, botanical ribs and responding orbital paths.
assets.symbolism: One source of creative energy generates many branches.
assets.technology: Procedural SphereGeometry, merged ribs, custom GLSL shell, additive light plane.
assets.interaction: Pointer bends orbital orientation; activation expands shell and releases particles and six destination objects; growth reveals roots.
assets.websiteUse: Homepage origin, navigation portal and chapter transition.
assets.mobile: 24-segment shell, DPR 1, 24 release particles; still fallback.
assets.status: prototype; art direction and browser/device review pending

assets.name: Living Root Network
assets.concept: 36 procedural golden paths carrying energy downward.
assets.symbolism: Purpose and values feed every output.
assets.technology: Deterministic CatmullRom curves, merged TubeGeometry, branch/growth vertex attributes, GLSL.
assets.interaction: Controlled growth clips the mesh progressively; selection routes a brighter moving signal.
assets.mobile: 25 curve segments, 4 radial sides; same selection and growth semantics.
assets.status: prototype; art direction and browser/device review pending

assets.name: Celestial Branch Network
assets.concept: 18 branching paths terminating in six creative domains, with instanced curved leaves.
assets.symbolism: Many forms of expression connect to one trunk.
assets.technology: Batched tube meshes and instanced leaf surfaces.
assets.interaction: Domain hover, keyboard focus and selection change the branch illumination.
assets.mobile: 48 instanced leaves; HTML controls mirror canvas destinations.
assets.status: prototype; art direction and browser/device review pending

assets.name: Resonance Bloom

assets.technology: Procedural React Three Fiber geometry; repeated parts instanced where useful.

assets.websiteUse: Album gateway, track selection, audio player.
assets.mobile: Shared single canvas, DPR cap, still asset; sound opt-in.
assets.status: prototype; art direction and browser/device review pending

assets.name: Cinematic Lifecycle

assets.name: Seed Energy Release
assets.concept: Transient energy points travel from a core to six destinations.

assets.status: prototype; art direction and browser/device review pending
